== Unverified historical chapter attribution ==
A previous article version described the phrase as chapter 7 of Phyllis C. Kaufman and Arnold Corrigan’s 1987 Understanding Buying and Selling a House. The chapter attribution has not been verified from the book text and is retained here for further source checking. The original wording and reference remain in the article’s earlier history.
